Welcome! My name is Casey.

People science · Organizational analytics · Research design

I am a people science and organizational analytics researcher interested in workplace dynamics and how organizational policies influence employee well-being.

I design and conduct studies using randomized experiments, complex survey designs, and interviews. I analyze quantitative and qualitative data using statistical and machine learning methods, using reproducible end-to-end workflows that turn research into practical, clear insights for organizations.
